notes:
• Player: separate Audio, Subtitles and Video buttons, each with its own panel and tabs to hop between them. Menus are see-through so the video stays visible
• New Sound choice: Original, Dialogue boost (clearer voices) or Night mode (loud scenes down, quiet talking up), remembered on each device
• New Picture choice: Fit, Fill, Stretch or Zoom. OK now brings up the controls first; OK again pauses
• Dolby Vision your TV can't do (profile 7 on many TVs, Sony's included) plays its HDR10 picture with the right colours. TVs that do Dolby Vision keep it. New setting: Dolby Vision › Play as HDR10
• Info panel shows the TV's real output resolution
• Continue Watching and Next Episode cards show the episode's own picture
• Dropped streams: leaving a stuck or switching source keeps your spot; a server that never answers is given up on after about 30 seconds; a fresh link comes from another linked debrid when the file is cached there; a source that won't start is dropped after 45 seconds and Sources opens again
• Stremio add-ons with direct links (Plexio for Plex, and others): the add-on's own name, real file size, stream kind (Direct Play, Transcode 720p) and its subtitle files
• Trakt stays linked more reliably (each renewal sent once and saved straight away). If Trakt ends a sign-in, Settings and Home say so instead of showing empty rows
• Updates: the update window closes once the install starts; Android 12 and newer install with no prompt and reopen ValFlix; ValFlix shows what's new after updating, and the notes scroll with the remote
• Phones and tablets: double-tap left or right to skip 10 seconds (keep tapping to skip further); player buttons fit small screens and Info sits at the top right. TV is unchanged
